title: Add choice-bearing prose coverage gate for SRD records
description:
Problem:
The current choice-coverage audit reports 60 structured choices and 0 findings, but it mostly validates choices that already exist. It does not reliably detect SRD records that contain build-choice prose without structured choices or option catalogs.

Examples from the 2026-06-29 audit:
- feature:warlock:pact-boon has Pact of the Chain / Blade / Tome only in prose.
- feature:warlock:eldritch-invocations embeds 32 invocations in prose behind one generic choice.
- feature:hunter:hunters-prey, defensive-tactics, multiattack, and superior-hunters-defense have option lists in prose.
- feature:sorcerer:metamagic has one generic choice while the eight options are prose only.
- Fighting Style features expose generic choice text but not structured option refs/effects.
- Bard Magical Secrets and Wizard Spell Mastery / Signature Spells are not structured spell choices.

Implement:
- Add a source/record audit that scans feature, class, subclass, ancestry, background, and similar records for choice-bearing language.
- Detect phrases such as:
  - choose one of the following
  - choose two
  - gain one of the following
  - select one
  - options
  - you learn additional spells of your choice
  - prerequisite
- Report records where choice-like prose exists but no structured choices, choice options, option catalog, spell-choice filter, or explicit allowlist explains the gap.
- Make the report actionable: record id, source location, matched phrase, surrounding snippet, and expected modeling area.
- Start as a report-only or warning gate if needed, but acceptance should include known 2026-06-29 misses being detected.

Acceptance criteria:
- The audit detects the known unstructured option cases listed above.
- False positives can be documented with a narrow allowlist and reason.
- The report is emitted into the audit bundle.
- Existing tests pass.
- The audit does not rely on LLM interpretation.
